headline: Watch: Hormuz shipping attacks and uncertain US-Iran talks keep fuel risk the main concern, with no confirmed impacts on Australia.
summary: No change since the 04:45 check. Ships are still being struck near Hormuz and US-Iran talks are uncertain, but oil is down about 5% to US$93.70 and markets are calmer. Iran-linked hacks of internet-connected refrigeration systems (food and blood storage) in Europe, Israel and the US are worth noting for cold-chain operators, but none are reported in Australia. All Australian phone and internet networks are normal and there are no SA weather emergencies.
